description: Structural navigation under pressure: find the longest public method in a class large enough that whole-file reads should not be cheaper than reading the symbol table. Tests whether the agent reaches for structural inspection (method index, line ranges) instead of dumping the entire source. Graded on the method name only — line numbers are not stable across releases.
prompt: Look at class `cl_abap_compiler`. Among its public methods, find the one with the longest method body (largest line range). Reply with only the method name.
notes: Stable SAP-standard target. The answer (method name) is stable across releases; line ranges drift, so they are deliberately not part of the rubric. The prompt still rewards agents that use structural inspection — picking the longest method requires line-range data even if the answer doesn't include it.
